title: Maximus of Tyre, Dissertations (Διαλέξεις), 41 lectures; unit = the 34 without Russian / Максим Тирский, Речи
author: Maximus of Tyre
edition: Trapp, Teubner 1994; Koniaris 1995. Public domain: Hobein, Teubner 1910.
ru_evidence: Russian Wikipedia: Or. 2 and Or. 36 (1961) and Or. 5 (1990). ΣΧΟΛΗ abstracts: new Russian translations of Or. 8–9 and 20–21. So 7 of 41.
en_evidence: M. B. Trapp, Maximus of Tyre: The Philosophical Orations (Oxford 1997), complete (from memory; not re-checked online).
value: Accessible popular Platonism on God, prayer, daimons, love, Homer and the Cynic life. Preserves lyric fragments (Sappho). Excellent for students; a major Russian gap in the Second Sophistic.
ai_feasibility: High. Lucid lecture prose; well-edited text; easy to cross-check with Trapp.
pilot_unit: Or. 11 (Who is God according to Plato?), estimated about 5,000 words.
